integrity: The standalone checker was executed on extracted working files; its finite mod-two and Lefschetz tests are corroborative. The general integral theorem rests on a direct topological and chain-level proof.
limitations: Only uniformly two-edge subdivided stars with m>=3 arms and r>=2; integral representation is not an equivariant homotopy splitting. Independent mathematical validation and exhaustive literature exclusion are not claimed.
title: Threshold phase diagram and integral symmetry homology of once-subdivided star independence complexes
